visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A top-down perspective reveals a light-colored wooden tray containing two circular cucumber slices with visible seeds and a pair of small blue tweezers. The tray sits on a textured wooden surface beside a warm, flickering candle housed in a dark ceramic jar. (2) A man with short-cropped hair and a neat brown beard wears a blue polo shirt with a white circular pattern. He looks directly at the lens and smiles broadly, displaying his teeth, while positioned in an indoor space with warm ambient lighting and wooden wall slats behind him. (3) A hand holds a red and cream-colored rectangular face mask package toward the camera. The packaging features a detailed illustration of a bowl of beef noodle soup and prominent traditional Chinese characters reading '牛肉麵' alongside the English text 'Taiwanese Delicacy Flavored Facial Masks'. (4) Hands carefully place the two cucumber slices over the eyes of the man as he lies down on a bed with neutral-toned pillows. A subsequent close-up shot shows a hand using the blue tweezers to point at a small red blemish on the man's forehead above the cucumber. (5) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and pearl earrings, opens the face mask package. She reacts with a dramatic, wide-eyed surprised expression and a grimace as she pulls out a wet, white sheet mask and smells it in front of the man. (6) The woman drapes the white sheet mask over the man's face, completely covering his features while he remains lying down. She then reaches under the mask to remove the cucumber slices from his eyes as they both laugh and talk during the application process. (7) The mask is removed, and a close-up shows the man's damp and glistening facial skin. He smiles and laughs at the camera while adjusting his hair, which is tied back in a small bun, as he jokes about the results of the skincare treatment.
